description: Creates, replaces or (panel: null) deletes a back office screen: rows of a table, a booking set or a credit kind, with columns, filters and row buttons (booking, credits or row changes) that act at once when pressed. Live at once in pro and pre, no promote; 30 per app. It sees every user and table, so it is never shown in the app. Who sees it: neblla_team panels. More: neblla_get_llms tools/set_panel

appId.description: The app's public ID, from neblla_list_apps.

name.description: The panel's name: letters, digits, _ or - (up to 40).

panel.description: { title, source, columns, where, filters, orderBy, limit, actions }, or null to delete it.

name: neblla_set_panel
title: Save a back office panel
